name: github
tagline: Governed Git operations with three built-in agents. GitHub today, GitLab and Gitea planned.
description: GitQ is the governed Git layer for QuoxCORE. It ships three built-in agents: GitQ (the concierge for onboarding, org and repo awareness, credential setup and RepoBrain indexing), Vulcan (issue triage, pull requests and release notes) and Gripe (one-line issue filing from the terminal). Around them: a cross-repo issue board and PR view, org-scoped credential vault, a feedback-to-issue pipeline with dedup and redaction, governed release management, policy gates, and VOLT audit trails. GitHub is live now; GitLab and Gitea are planned on the same governed provider seam.
shortDescription: Governed Git: cross-repo issues, PRs, three agents (GitQ, Vulcan, Gripe), vault credentials, and audited releases. GitHub live; GitLab and Gitea planned.
author: QUOX

githubToken.label: Personal Access Token
githubToken.description: GitHub PAT with repo and read:org scopes. Stored in the Integrations Vault when available. See docs for setup.

syncInterval.label: Sync Interval (minutes)
syncInterval.description: How often to sync issues and PRs from GitHub.

marketingPoints: Three built-in agents: GitQ onboards you, Vulcan triages issues and drafts PRs, Gripe files one-liners from the terminal
Cross-repo issue board and PR view: every repo in your org, one panel, zero tab-switching
Org-scoped vault credentials: encrypted token storage, multi-org support, no browser tokens
Feedback pipeline: website forms become issues with 24h dedup and email redaction
Governed release management with a changelog page, a recent-changes feed, and VOLT audit trails
Server-side proxy: every provider API call routed through QuoxCORE, nothing leaves the browser
GitHub live today; GitLab and Gitea planned on the same governed provider seam

issueBoard.name: Cross-Repo Issue Board
issueBoard.description: Unified view of issues across all repositories. Filter by repo, label, status, and assignee. Inline actions and markdown rendering.

prView.name: PR View
prView.description: Open pull requests across all repos with review status, CI results, and merge readiness.

gitqConcierge.name: GitQ concierge
gitqConcierge.description: The onboarding agent: connects your provider token to the org vault, maps orgs and repos, and hands repositories to RepoBrain for indexing. Chat-native, no setup screen to learn.

forgeAgent.name: Vulcan agent
forgeAgent.description: Triages issues, drafts pull requests and writes release notes in natural language. Every action is AEE-witnessed and pull-request creation is held for human approval.

gripeAgent.name: Gripe agent
gripeAgent.description: One line in, a filed and labelled issue out. Files straight from the terminal you are already in, and refuses to say filed without an issue URL.

feedbackPipeline.name: Feedback Pipeline
feedbackPipeline.description: Website feedback forms create GitHub issues automatically. 24h dedup, email redaction for public repos, source labels.

releaseManager.name: Release Management
releaseManager.description: Governed releases with auto-generated changelogs, deploy checklists, and VOLT audit trails.

policyGates.name: Policy Gates
policyGates.description: Enforce branch protection, required reviews, and CI checks across all repositories.

orgMapping.name: Org Mapping
orgMapping.description: Map GitHub organisations to Quox organisations. Multi-org support with scope filtering.

changelog.name: Changelog Page
changelog.description: Changelog page and recent changes feed. Full notification pipeline planned.

voltAudit.name: VOLT Logging
voltAudit.description: Every destructive action logged with cryptographic receipts via VOLT protocol.

vaultCredentials.name: Vault Credentials
vaultCredentials.description: GitHub PATs stored server-side. Configure the Integrations Vault for encrypted storage. Proxy keeps tokens off the browser.

tokenExpiry.name: Token Expiry Detection
tokenExpiry.description: Monitors PAT expiry dates and warns before credentials stop working.

deployChecklist.name: Deploy Checklist
deployChecklist.description: Pre-release checklist with CI pass gates, review requirements, and approval workflow.

requirements.external: GitHub account with repo and read:org scopes

changelog.2.1.0: GitQ: renamed from GitHub Operations to a provider-agnostic Git product. Three built-in agents (GitQ concierge, Vulcan, Gripe). GitHub live; GitLab and Gitea planned.
changelog.2.0.0: v2: Vulcan agent, vault credentials, org mapping, PR view, deploy checklist, token expiry detection
changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: cross-repo issues, feedback pipeline, sidebar agent

includedInNote: Added to the Dev Suite bundle 2026-08-19 (owner decision). Gripe and Triage both file through GitHub, so the bundle carries ONE org-scoped credential rather than each plugin holding its own PAT. The credential resolves by the org a dev server is assigned to.
